verdict.rationale: Ramp documents AI automations that cover the core close workload. Its AI agents auto-capture receipts and fill in memos and categories. Transactions are auto-categorized from history and feedback, and coded transactions sync directly to the ERP. Invoices are auto-matched to POs and coded to GL accounts. Real-time bidirectional ERP sync is said to eliminate manual journal entries, and Ramp claims 100% of its payments are auto-reconciled. Missing for 10: no explicit month-end close workflow or measured close-time reduction (e.g., days saved), no evidence on accruals or close checklists, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the accounting automation (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
